nodes.text: Yeah, I haven't been spending time with you...

nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben

nodes.speaker: Taylor

nodes.text: I don't know... The tables do feel like they have rotated some...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Has he invited you to any of his parties? Could you even sit at the Center Table without getting beaten up?!

nodes.speaker: Erik

nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.text: Uhhh...

The Centerscore half of the crowd erupts with laughter.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ha! His mom!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Again? Really? What information do you guys have about my mom?
The laughter continues.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Quiet down! Have any of you actually met Chad's mom? She's a Senator!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Why are you laughing?! Is there something funny about her?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean, besides her face?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! `Face!`

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nice one, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The best insults are the ones they don't get!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Really? `Spartan's` going to lose the `Spartan` Games?
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan's[/i][/color] going to lose the [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan[/i][/color] Games?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Yes.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Maybe you didn't hear me just now. These games are being held `on Carson's father's estate...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe you didn't hear me just now. These games are being held [color=#e23b3b][i]on Carson's father's estate...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Does that count as a home field advantage? I believe it does!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Burn! Backbutter confirms!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: What did I say about talking, Mark?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Do you still think someone from Centerscore's going to win?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah! That's what I thought.
$ZOE steadies herself!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Found my footing!
She takes one step and then another...
When she nearly slips again, she rights herself, and soon she is halfway across!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm doing it! I'm really doing it!
Behind her, the cheerleaders try to follow her lead.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh... Don't look down... Don't look down...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Isn't that what you do when you're high up?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm not going to stand here and watch my white shoes pick up river mud. I can't! And I won't!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I see a fish!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is so lame...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm out here... Crossing a river... Getting everything dirty and... And...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh!
Jessica loses her footing on the rock just ahead of $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Watch it!
Jessica topples into the water.
A moment later, she emerges and tries to rise unsteadily to her feet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here, take my hand.
Jessica takes $ZOE's hand and makes her way back onto the rocks.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just glad you're okay!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It was a 'thank you', not an award. Geez. Stop being so cheerful.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Move out!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: They found us! The Spartans have found us!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda! Save yourself! Save yourself!
Jessica and $ZOE turn to look. They see Chad and a bunch of Spartan boys ruthlessly shoot down Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You may have taken Nicole, but you won't get Amanda!
Hector jumps in front of his girlfriend, as another volley fires!
He lands on the ground splattered in paint.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Go on without me, babe...
Amanda backs up, her hands brought up to the side of her head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm saying I'm tired of your flack and your getting us into trouble, and I want you out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... I'm the one that led you guys here!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'm not grateful, so scram.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't toss me out of the group!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure I can! I'm the captain, remember?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, fine! I'm leaving you guys anyway!
$ZOE picks up her gun and runs into the forest.
Away from the girls, she can feel tears prick at her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Think they can survive without me?! I'd like to see them try!
$ZOE plunges deeper into the forest. When she looks up again, she's hopelessly lost.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where... Where am I?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: About to be taken out!
From behind a tree, Chad steps out and points his gun at $ZOE.
He shoots!
And a paintball mark appears in the middle of $ZOE's chest.
Oh no! $ZOE has failed!
But she can't leave the Spartan Games now!
Try again and see if you can prevent Jessica from kicking her out!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Jessica pulls $ZOE aside.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What did you want to talk about?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, it's been kind of a stressful day.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't like being shot at, getting separated from my boyfriend, or running in the wilderness with every bug, river, and clod of dirt thrown in my way.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I especially don't like you trying to take over the squad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... So?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Even if I don't like it... I have to admit that I'm not as good at this `nature` and `survival` thing as you are...
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if I don't like it... I have to admit that I'm not as good at this [color=#3b78e2][i]nature[/i][/color] and [color=#3b78e2][i]survival[/i][/color] thing as you are...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, I just wanted to say 'thanks' and to tell you that, for now, I'll listen to you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But don't think I'll tolerate it when we're in school again and things are back to normal!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course not.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You think we can win these games?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope so...
$ZOE is suddenly interrupted by loud shouts in the distance!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole? You really think Nicole's our best bet?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Hector and Amanda would probably just make out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm not going to lie... That probably would have happened.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Really? You'd do that here?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, we're fleeing for our fake lives here. Tensions are running high, girlfriends are wanting to be kissed...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Point taken. Okay, Nicole. Stay here with Hector.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Aw, come on... My hair's ruined, my makeup rubbed off, and my feet are tired.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No one said you had to stand up to stand guard.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Besides, you'll get the chance to tan when you're done.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I guess.
Nicole and Hector sit facing the entrance to the woods, their guns at the ready.
Amanda wanders down to the lake to dip her toes in.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure. I don't really care. Amanda and Hector, go stand guard over there.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure thing, Captain.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, I was thinking... This might be a good time for you to show me that lip thing again...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And again, baby!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, no way! Don't you two spend the whole time making out!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No... Not the `whole` time!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Tee hee...
They run off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's like we're not even at war...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah really.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, I'm off to tan!
Nicole wanders down to the lake and plops down in the warm sand.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Everybody, come here and huddle!`
Nicole, Amanda, and Hector come back and crowd around Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As much as I hate to admit it, $ZOE's right about the Spartans. They're still after us.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Awww... No tanning?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I didn't say that, did I?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We can swim and tan, but... We need to set up a guard or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But we should probably have two just in case.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine. Who else wants to sit with Hector? Any volunteers?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh, I un-volunteer...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I want to build a sand castle...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can do it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No. I need to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, then I really think it should be....

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Jessica, but that's not a good idea. The Spartans are still hunting us!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We should at least set up a guard or...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wasn't `asking` for your opinion, was I?
nodes.text_bbcode: I wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]asking[/i][/color] for your opinion, was I?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: In fact, I don't think anyone here was interested in what you had to say, were they?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, no one said anything, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I said before that `I'm still in charge!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I said before that [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm still in charge![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So I'd appreciate it if you kept your negative comments to yourself.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're getting totes annoying.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I shouldn't have said anything...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I was about to say...
$ZOE waits.
Jessica looks from the beach to the woods to the beach and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What do you think, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm asking what you think. About now. About us being here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, this is as good a spot as any to make camp.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're better protected here. With the water behind us, the only spot we'd have to really watch is the path we came on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As long as a couple people stand guard, we can relax... For now.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah... Okay... Maybe you're not just full of `lame` ideas.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't get too excited.
Jessica calls out to the other cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Stop, you guys!
$ZOE loses her balance and tilts over! She makes a grab for something, anything...
And latches onto Jessica's arm!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Stop it! Don't do that! I can't...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Aaaaaaaah!`
They both topple into the river!
A moment later, Jessica rises unsteadily to her feet in the moving water and splashes $ZOE who falls back down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This... Is all... Your fault!
Jessica slips again.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I can help! Hang on!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay!
Amanda puts a hand on Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not you, Manda-Panda... Though this is nice...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A little help here?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Here, Jessica, take my hand.
Hector pulls her up.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Here, $ZOE... Take hold of my hand!
$ZOE takes Amanda's hand and gets back on the rocks. The cheerleaders cross the river at last.
On land, Jessica angrily wrings out her wet clothes and glares at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Next time you feel like taking a dive, leave me out of it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Move out!
The cheerleaders find the river and follow its meandering path through the woods.
Eventually they come up to a place where raging river rapids block the path.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We can't go any further.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, I knew this was a bad idea! We should have gone the other way!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Calm down...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No way! I'm mad! Now we have to go back!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, we don't. I see a sloping path down to the bottom on the other side of the river.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All we have to do is cross.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Are you joking? I'm wearing white sneakers!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No way am I stepping into any part of `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No way am I stepping into any part of [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, maybe we shouldn't cross `here`, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, maybe we shouldn't cross [color=#3b78e2][i]here[/i][/color], but...

nodes.text: Jessica points at the roiling water of the river. The water streams quickly by, picking up speed as it approaches the rapids' crest.
$ZOE looks upstream and sees a wider, calmer part of the river where stepping stones are clearly available. She runs to it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Up here! We can cross here! The water's not too deep.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh goodie.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Does someone want to carry me across? I'd be their best friend forever...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No way.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're already my second-in-command. I don't need you to be more.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now move aside, $ZOE. If we're crossing this river, all of you are going to be behind me!
Jessica cautiously steps onto the first rock, then the second, and so on... The other cheerleaders follow.
$ZOE goes next. She takes one tentative step... And loses her footing on the mossy rocks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is a faster river than I thought!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Being near water is our best chance at surviving.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: How do you even know that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I may have read it somewhere... But just think about all the running we're doing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If we're in the Spartan Games for more than a day, we'll need to find a water source anyway.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm getting thirsty just thinking about water.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I guess I am too...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, we can't go back into the forest.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The Spartan boys are there, and they seem to know the forest pretty well.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If they're as experienced at this as they say they are, they have an advantage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'll be easier for us if we can see them coming, and I think having water at our backs would help.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But... But what about the people we left behind? Like Ben?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want to find my boyfriend too, but we can't right now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But if we get caught now, we won't be able to help either of them.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think $ZOE's right.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And I think Ben can handle himself.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Fine.` Let's go with `$ZOE's` `perfect` plan.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We follow the river.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I knew it! You just suggested water so you could get back to your boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's part of the reason, but... But...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No. We're going with my plan.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All we need to do is get back into the forest, find Ben, and...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, is this whole plan to go back into the scary forest with all the evil Spartan just `your` way of looking for `your` boyfriend?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, is this whole plan to go back into the scary forest with all the evil Spartan just [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] way of looking for [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's not the reason!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, maybe it's `part` of the reason...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, maybe it's [color=#3b78e2][i]part[/i][/color] of the reason...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But only, like, three-fourths!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Ahhhh!` Fractions!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Enough! Ladies, listen!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Instead of trying to find boyfriends...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What about just finding a safe place to hang out?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I like $ZOE's water idea...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Only because all that running made me thirsty.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And isn't water one of the things we need anyway if we're going to be out here for a while?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But what about Ben?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure Ben will figure something out. He's very resourceful.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You `would` say that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, but she's right. Ben will be okay. But we won't be unless we get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Fine.` Let's follow the river.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... Uh... For Howard?
After many tense, breathless minutes, the forest opens up.
The cheerleaders find themselves in another section of the estate, this part a picturesque, well-manicured lawn.
They rush into a protected gazebo and catch their breaths.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We made it! We're in the clear!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait, is that a good thing?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Please tell me we can just stop running now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. We'll rest here for a minute, but then we're leaving. The Spartan boys won't quit, and...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nothing, I'm just saying...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're not just 'saying' anything. You're `ordering` the squad around.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not just 'saying' anything. You're [color=#3b78e2][i]ordering[/i][/color] the squad around.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I shouldn't have to remind you that even if we're in the middle of frikkin' nowhere, I'm `still` Cheer Captain, and that means I'm in charge!
nodes.text_bbcode: I shouldn't have to remind you that even if we're in the middle of frikkin' nowhere, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] Cheer Captain, and that means I'm in charge!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... Captain.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... What should we do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Obviously, we can't stay here. The boys will catch up to us.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: So where do we go?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Let me think a minute...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We don't have time to 'think for a minute'!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I need to find Howard, but where would he be?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Water! Where there are ducks, there's Howard. And there's a good chance Sam might be there too... Which means we need to find a lake or something!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay girls, here's the plan. Normally in a crisis like this, I go to the mall...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But there is no mall...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know that! So I propose that we go back into the forest.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because I said so!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica, I don't think that's a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And what do you suggest?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We need to head for water. I think I saw a rushing stream where we were running.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If we follow it, we might be able to find a lake or someplace we can set up a camp!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How is going towards water any better than going into the woods?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... We need to get to water...
$ZOE makes to tackle Carson, but stumbles!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I won't make it in time!
She watches helpless as Carson levels the gun at Hector's chest with a good-natured smile.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Sorry, old chap...
At that moment, an Amazonian war cry can be heard throughout the forest!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: What's... What's that?!
Amanda hurtles out from behind a tree and body slams Carson!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: `Whoa!`

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No one touches my Hecky-Wecky!
Hector turns to Carson.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ha! Now the tables have turned, haven't they?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You want some paint to go with that smarmy smile?
Hector starts to shoot Carson when paint pellets explode near his head!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There are still some people behind us! Run!
They all sprint away!
$ZOE dashes after them before Carson can fully recover.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, you don't!
$ZOE bursts forward with renewed speed and tackles Carson to the ground, right before he pulls the trigger!
Paintballs released from the gun spray up in the air like a fountain!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Got him!
When they hit the ground, $ZOE rolls free of Carson and onto her feet!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE.
Hector turns to Carson.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ha! Now the tables have turned, haven't they?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You want some paint to go with that smarmy smile?
Hector starts to shoot Carson when paint pellets explode near his head!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There are still some people behind us! Run!
They all sprint away!
$ZOE freezes!
$ZOE runs ahead and sees the remaining cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Some people did make it!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We're almost out of the woods! My mall sense is tingling!
Just as Nicole says those words, Carson steps out from around a tree!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: `Ahhhh!!!`

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Ahhhh!!!`

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `You!`

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Hector, fancy meeting you here.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I refuse to be killed by this sham of a guy!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: That's too bad.
Carson raises his paintball gun.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Because you're about to.
$ZOE ducks her head and runs in the opposite direction, weaving around trees for cover.
Paintballs slap color onto the trees around her, but $ZOE remains untouched!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was close!
Behind her, $ZOE hears the cries of her fellow cheerleaders as they go down.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Noooo!!!`

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `This shirt is brand new!`

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Keith... I'll always remember you!
$ZOE trips and tumbles to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahhh! No!
$ZOE manages to roll to her feet, but Preston is close to her.
He levels his gun... He aims...
And just as he squeezes the trigger, Keith steps into his line of fire and gets shot!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Noooo!!!`

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `This shirt is brand new!`
While Keith bitterly walks off the grounds, $ZOE takes the opportunity to run deeper into the forest!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought he had me!
Fallen leaves and dry twigs snap beneath her feet as she rushes through the forest.
In the chaos, it's hard to see anything save the girls beside her or the trees whipping past.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We're... Huff... Outpacing Chad... Huff... I think!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just Chad? Where are his henchmen?
And that's when $ZOE sees a shadowy figure moving around in the trees!
The figure jumps out, brandishing his weapon!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Got you now!
$ZOE banks left, cutting into a cluster of trees and yelling behind her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Watch out! There's a Spartan on the right!
$ZOE hears the whirring of a paintball gun as it spits out a magazine of ammo!
$ZOE changes course at the last second, avoiding the web entirely!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank goodness!
She runs on.
She plunges into the web! Instantly, sticky tendrils cling to her hair and face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Eeeeeek!`

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gross gross gross gross!
She tears at her face, whipping the web aside as she tries to run straight.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Way to not alert the Spartans...
$ZOE can't stop herself in time!
Now that you've seen what Ben's been up to, we're going to take a look at how $ZOE is faring.
Rewinding back to when the Spartan ambush started...
As more Spartans crest over the hill, all of Centerscore scatters!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: $ZOE?! $ZOE?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Howard?! Where are you?!
In the rush, Jessica and the cheerleaders get swept away from Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! Ben!
Jessica starts to turn back for him, but $ZOE grabs her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on! You'll get shot if you go back!
$ZOE pulls Jessica away, and the two girls regroup with the cheerleaders.
The cheerleading squad runs like a pack of gazelles!
Back at the start, Chad and a group of Spartan boys watch them.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! They should have split up.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hunting them down as a large group will be easier than shooting pigeons in the dark...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Is that... A thing you do?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Shut up, Carson.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Let's get down to chasing these girls. They're cheerleaders. Easy pickings.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Spartans, to me! We're going to hunt them down!
The Spartans assemble behind Chad. Chad turns to Carson and Preston.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You two, hold up a minute...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yes, boss?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Take the shortcut in the woods to get ahead of them. We'll send them your way, and you finish the job. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: The pincer attack?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: The pincer attack. Now move out!
Meanwhile, in the forest, $ZOE and the cheerleaders run frantically!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Can we stop running now?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, I hate... Huff... Running! It's messing up my hair!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Mine too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Run run run!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The Spartans are out there, and Howard's all by himself...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Sam... I hope she's okay too... But if I'm going to see both of them, I have to live through this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We keep moving! They aren't that far behind us!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How can you be so sure?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, I can't even hear them.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Surely they've given up by now...
Keith slows down, and all the other cheerleaders follow suit.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Keep moving!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And just who died and made you the boss of us?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not the boss of anyone! I just don't think we're safe...
Suddenly, the whizzing of paintballs cuts $ZOE off!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Eeek!!!`

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Paint!`

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Keep your head low and run!
$ZOE sprints away from the paintballs, the other cheerleaders following her lead.
As $ZOE plunges further into the wooded area, she glances back and sees Chad falling behind them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe we can outrun him!
When $ZOE turns to look straight ahead, she sees a large spider's web stretched across two tree trunks!

nodes.text: They press forward, going down the mountain trail.
At the bottom of the trail is a larger pool of water where the stream opens up into a lake.
The cheerleaders run to the beachy area.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I can tan!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's beautiful out here! Can we swim?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You want to swim? But you don't even have suits!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Not a problem for me.
Nicole takes her shirt off, revealing a stunning bikini.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why are you wearing that?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You know, just in case I get cornered by a Spartan guy and have to talk my way out of it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And you needed a bikini...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Every little piece helps!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emphasis on the `little...`

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I could use a nap.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I guess we can have a little down time...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! We can't let our guard down now!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Hector! Noooooo!!!`
Amanda charges at the Spartans, her gun shooting paintballs in random directions!
She takes out a handful of them, but there are still a few left who dodge her attacks.
When Amanda's clip empties, Carson steps up to her.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I hate to do this to a beautiful woman, but...
Carson points his gun to shoot.
Amanda raises her gun reflexively and deflects it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Whoa, that was kind of awesome...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You want to see something awesome?
Amanda hurls her empty paintball gun at Carson. It hits him square in the chest, and he topples over!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ow!
Amanda runs to stand near Jessica and $ZOE. The three girls retreat towards the water.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, what's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We shoot them.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I can't! I threw Lucy out!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, $ZOE and I can take them!
Jessica aims and shoots at Preston and Chad!
But nothing happens!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: My gun! It's not working...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I think it broke when I fell in the water!
Chad and his cronies approach the girls.
Their backs to the water, $ZOE, Jessica, and Amanda ponder their imminent disqualification.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Well, well, well... Looks like you ladies have one gun and nowhere to turn.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Let me handle this.
Jessica puts on her best sad face and pleads with Chad.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Please, you don't have to do this.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't think you really want to pull the trigger.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Clearly, you don't know me.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah really. He hasn't had a girlfriend in forever. The sad puppy face won't work on him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, drat.
$ZOE steps up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can't we strike up some sort of deal?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: We don't deal with terrorists!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're not terrorists. We're `girls.` We're harmless... We don't pose a threat to you.
nodes.text_bbcode: We're not terrorists. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]girls.[/i][/color] We're harmless... We don't pose a threat to you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wouldn't it be more of a challenge to let us get our bearings, practice shooting at things, and then face us down later?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No! I didn't come here looking for a challenge, I came here to win!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Which is why you're going down now! Boys, ready your aim!
The Spartan boys raise their paintball guns.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm too young to be sprayed with paint!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love paint, but why does it have to be so mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I'm going down, at least one of them is coming with me!
$ZOE pumps her gun.
Just as the boys are about to shoot...

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: `Stop right there, or you'll be blue and green before you can even say the word 'Mommy'!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Stop right there, or you'll be blue and green before you can even say the word 'Mommy'![/i]

nodes.text: $ZOE turns to the sound of the voice...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... It's `you!`
Just who is $ZOE talking to? And are they friend or foe?
Will $ZOE be rescued, or will she be shot?
Find out next time on Surviving High School!
As soon as they're gone, the bell sounds!
The Centerscore crowd surges toward the ladder! Ben gets shoved forward!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
He's pushed toward the ladder! He climbs, following the people in front of him up to...
The top of an enormous slide!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Gulp!` Long way down!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hurry up, dummy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... So?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Even if I don't like it... I have to admit that I'm not as good at this `nature` and `survival` thing as you are...
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if I don't like it... I have to admit that I'm not as good at this [color=#3b78e2][i]nature[/i][/color] and [color=#3b78e2][i]survival[/i][/color] thing as you are...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, I just wanted to say 'thanks' and to tell you that, for now, I'll listen to you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But don't think I'll tolerate it when we're in school again and things are back to normal!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course not.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You think we can win these games?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope so...
$ZOE is suddenly interrupted by loud shouts in the distance!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We could get Erik's arm out of the trap if we could put some oil in there... Something that would make his arm slick enough...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're in a forest, Ben, not a grocery store!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Taylor! Do you have any hairspray on you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She's not going to have hairspray on her during the Spart...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Here.
Taylor reaches into one of her boots and hands a small bottle of hairspray to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're in the wild! You never know when you're going to have a bad hair day...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hurry, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guys, look around for any plants that look like this!
Ben grabs several leaves off a nearby plant.
A minute later, the nerds return with a handful of leaves.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good!
Ben starts cramming the leaves into the bottle of hairspray.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The compounds in the hairspray should react with these leaves...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It should create a new solution with the right viscosity for freeing Erik.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Blah blah blah, biscuity shmiscuity. All I know is my hairspray is ruined!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Guys! Shh! Listen!
Everyone quiets down... Just enough to hear the sound of the Spartans coming toward them!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Hurry!
Ben applies the new solution to the trap around Erik's arm...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope this works!
Ben pulls as hard as he can... And jerks Erik's arm free!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Come on!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Grab Erik, and let's get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guys, wait!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: There's no time!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We know where they're going to be...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, spraying us with paintballs in about thirty seconds!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I mean they're coming to this trap...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And what happens in Ogres 'N' Elves when goblins return to an activated trap?
Slowly, collectively, the nerds smile...
Thirty seconds later, a group of Spartans stands about a hundred yards away from the trap.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: The alarm definitely went off. I just don't understand why there isn't someone stuck inside the trap.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Marcus! Go investigate!
One lone freshman Spartan steps out of the pack...

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: This is so stupid.
Meanwhile, the nerds are huddled behind a fallen tree nearby...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: On three guys...
Marcus inspects the trap from close up...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One...
Marcus calls back to Chad and the others...

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: There's nothing here, Chad!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Something set off the alarm!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Two...
Marcus looks back to the trap... He takes another cautious step.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Three!
The nerds fire their guns at Marcus, instantly blanketing him with paint!

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Argh!
Before the rest of the Spartans can react, the nerds dash off into the woods, safe...
For now!
Congratulations! You helped Ben patch up some of the strained relations between him and the nerds!

We've seen what Ben and $ZOE are up to...
But how is the rest of Centerscore faring in the Spartan Games?
For Centerscore!
The swim team lays down cover fire for the retreating Centerscorians!
As the Spartans duck behind the hill, the swim team makes a break for it and runs into the forest for cover.
Deep in the forest, the swim team comes to a rest.
I think we finally put enough distance between us and those Spartan punks!
I can't believe they ambushed us!
`I` can. They've done this before.
They totally have the advantage.
What do we do now?
I'm not sure...
Sam scans the trees for an answer.
Through a small break in the forest, she sees a building off in the distance.
Look! Over there! I see a place where we can probably hole up or look for supplies.
The other girls look out into the distance.
Geez, that's really far away. Just how big `is` this property?!
Unbelievably big.
Come on. Let's just start walking.
After a long walk, Sam and the swim team find themselves in a large building.
It's a pool house! The pool is beautiful!
Wow, these Spartan boys are rich.
Yeah, yeah, don't be too impressed. They're rich, but arrogant.
Okay, now to find supplies.
Sam walks to the far end of the room where a row of lockers sits. She opens one.
Nothing.
She opens the next one.
Nothing... Come on... These guys have money bleeding out their ears, and these are all empty?
The next one she opens makes her cry out.
Hey, guys, take a look at this...
Sam points into the locker.
How fitting.
That's great!
These should give us a little bit of an edge, right?
Meanwhile, at another clearing in another part of the forest...
Colt is drawing diagrams in the dirt while Denni watches.
Okay, so they got the drop on us first, but that doesn't mean we're down for the count.
I didn't realize war would turn you into a man of many sports metaphors.
Hey...
I'm joking. Go on. You were saying?
So there are a bunch of Spartan guys between us and winning, right?
I see where you're going with this.
So we just blast them!
A little less clear now.
Our plan is going to be to isolate and shoot each one.
Look, between your one-liners and my brawn, we can take each of them down.
You don't want to take Chad down first?
Can't. He's too well protected. We have to whittle down his forces if we're going to have a shot at winning.
Okay, I'm good for this...
For the next few moments, Denni and Colt talk strategy. At last, Colt stands up.
Ready, Tiny Hipster?
Denni pumps her gun and stands beside him.
